crons.name: daily-pipeline-run
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/daily-pipeline-run/SKILL.md and follow it. Open the alert register first, before anything else. Work every Critical alert, then build the day view. Do not send anything; stage every owner-facing message for release.

crons.name: weekly-review-prep
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/pipeline-metrics-and-review/SKILL.md and follow it. Build this week's review pack: stage-by-stage walk, alerts still open, deals lost and why, pipeline-to-goal ratio. Stage it for the BD manager; do not send.

crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, and work your highest-priority open alert (speed-to-lead breach, unsigned agreement, overdue follow-up, no next action set, handoff unconfirmed).

_cron_note: Cron day/time literals are seat defaults, not answers. D9 asks when the weekly pipeline review happens and D7 asks the daily activity floor; neither question asks for a cron expression. Re-point these from seat-config.json cadence values at install.
